# AI Crawlability Test

> Free AI crawlability checker and crawl test tool — check whether your website has the key files AI crawlers and agents look for: llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, per-page markdown, and structured data. Use it to test website crawlability, run a crawling test, perform a crawler check, and get a full crawlability audit graded A–F.

## Tool

- [Home](/index.md): Free AI crawl test — enter a URL to instantly check whether llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and per-page markdown are present and properly configured.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions about AI crawlability, llms.txt, robots.txt for AI bots, structured data, and how to optimise for AI search engines.
- [About](/about): About the AI Crawlability Test tool — what it checks, why it matters, and who built it.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with questions, feedback, or partnership inquiries.

## Blog

- [What is llms.txt and Why Every Website Needs One](/blog/what-is-llms-txt.md): Introduction to the llms.txt specification, how it works, and why every website needs one to be visible to AI agents and LLMs.
- [How to Optimize Your Website for AI Search Engines](/blog/optimize-for-ai-search.md): A guide to Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — how to structure content so AI-powered search engines like Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude can cite your site.
- [robots.txt for AI Crawlers: A Complete 2025 Guide](/blog/robots-txt-ai-crawlers.md): How to configure robots.txt for AI bots — covers GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, and best practices for AI-friendly crawler configuration.
- [JSON-LD and Structured Data: Making Your Content AI-Readable](/blog/json-ld-structured-data.md): Practical guide to implementing JSON-LD schema markup to improve visibility in AI search engines and knowledge graphs.
- [The Complete Guide to AI Crawlability in 2025](/blog/ai-crawlability-guide-2025.md): Comprehensive checklist covering every layer of AI crawlability: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, Open Graph, JSON-LD, and per-page markdown.
- [Link Response Headers for Agent Discovery — RFC 8288 Explained](/blog/link-headers-agent-discovery.md): How HTTP Link headers let AI agents discover key resources without parsing HTML, with implementation examples for Next.js and nginx.
- [MCP Server Cards: How AI Agents Discover Your Site's Tools](/blog/mcp-server-card.md): What the MCP server card is, why /.well-known/mcp.json matters, and how to publish one so agents can discover and use your site's tools.
- [API, OAuth, and OIDC Discovery for AI Agents](/blog/api-oauth-agent-discovery.md): How AI agents discover API capabilities and authentication requirements — covering OpenAPI, ai-plugin.json, OAuth AS metadata (RFC 8414), and OIDC discovery.

## API

- [Check Files API](/api/check-files): Quick check endpoint — pass ?url= to test llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and per-page markdown for any domain.
- [Check Site API](/api/check-site): Full crawlability analysis — tests discovery, content, metadata, and access signals.
- [Check LLMs API](/api/check-llms): Detailed llms.txt parser — validates format, structure, and compliance with the llmstxt.org specification.
